checks.name: A committed translation produces one snapshot per selection root
Translation, rotation and scale each restore the exact captured baseline
Restoring is idempotent and does not drift on repeated cancel
Clearing the drag without restoring would strand the displacement (regression guard)
The editor Escape path cancels through the restore helper
Vertex drag cancel restores geometry and scale to the captured baseline
Vertex baseline is a copy: later edits cannot corrupt what will be restored
Vertex drag capture and cancel are wired into the editor paths
Both cancel entry points share one restore helper
